acceptanceCriteria: dogfood-bind-range.sh emits the same guarding-tests NOTE as the single-shot path
body: Found by the guarding-tests lane (PR #961, head b99b4991c, 2026-10-16). The single-shot bind path prints the `--guarding-tests` NOTE added for V1-1449/1453, but the staged path `script/dogfood-bind-range.sh` (used for >250-hunk changes) does not, so staged binds lose the hint. Expected: both bind paths emit the same NOTE.
title: dogfood: script/dogfood-bind-range.sh (the staged bind path) does not emit the guarding-tests NOTE
